messages:
maria (sec-eng): Heads-up — we have a Peregrine Health onboarding call tomorrow. They want a short evidence pack: sampled audit logs, KMS key provenance for Private deploy, RBAC change history, and a short incident tabletop. Can we assemble?

jamie (security): Also asked for ephemeral admin access for a 1-hr runbook test. Do we provide a temp service account and log the issuance? :thinking_face:

srini (infra): Yes we can. For audit samples we usually run a filtered export to SIEM and produce a signed manifest. Recommend: time-bounded slice + sha256 manifest + redaction.

alex (devex): I'll prepare an exporter script and example query. Sample SQL to pull the slice:

```
SELECT timestamp, actor, action, resource, outcome
FROM audit.events
WHERE tenant_id = 'peregrine'
  AND timestamp >= '2025-03-01T00:00:00Z'
  AND timestamp <  '2025-03-08T00:00:00Z'
LIMIT 5000;
```

We then scrub PII and include a hash summary of each file.

katie (customer-success): Peregrine specifically asked for proof that KMS keys are customer-controlled in Private. Do we have a one-pager on the envelope flow and rotation logs we can hand them?

maria (sec-eng): We do. Internal doc path: `docs/internal/kms-envelope-flow.pdf`. That includes provenance, rotation timeline, and HSM wrap statements. For the evidence bundle we'll include a short README that maps artifacts to questionnaire sections.

jamie (security): Auditor also wants RBAC change diffs for the last 90 days plus approval IDs. We store that in `iam.role_changes`. Export should include change, author, approval_ticket.

srini (infra): Redaction rules: remove IPs, remove raw tokens, redact usernames that are personal emails. Use the evidence playbook: produce signed tarball + manifest; GPG sign with `sec-eng-prod` key.

maria (sec-eng): We'll also show an incident timeline sample to demonstrate IR speed/traceability. Propose a 30-minute tabletop during the call — who can join?

alex (devex): I can. I'll also add the ephemeral cred creation example to the README: 

```
# create temp admin credential (example)
POST /infra-api/keys/temp
{ "tenant": "peregrine", "ttl": "1h", "scopes": ["admin:read","admin:write"] }
```

deploy-bot: audit-export job started: job_id=jekyll-882, ETA ~7m.

katie (customer-success): Confirm we'll include SLA metrics (latency percentiles) for the export window — customer asked to see operational KPIs.

maria (sec-eng): Affirmative. We'll include console screenshots (metrics), but redact IPs and any host identifiers. Also include the retention policy excerpt.

jamie (security): Quick vuln triage note while assembling: found a transitive dependency flagged `CVE-2024-4242` (low severity). I opened SEC-2345 with proposed mitigations and ETA to patch. We'll include that Jira link in the packet.

srini (infra): For SIEM ingest the customer asked for the JSON schema. Proposed payload snippet: 

```
{
  "timestamp": "ISO8601",
  "actor": "string",
  "action": "string",
  "resource": "string",
  "outcome": "success|failure",
  "request_id": "uuid"
}
```

maria (sec-eng): Deliverables checklist (target EOD tomorrow):
1) signed audit sample tarball (time-bounded, redacted)
2) KMS envelope flow pdf + rotation audit logs snapshot
3) RBAC diffs CSV with approval ticket ids
4) incident tabletop slide deck + brief script
5) mitigation summary & Jira link for vuln triage

alex (devex): I'll push the exporter script to an internal gist and link it inside the packet. Also add a short run command to reproduce the export locally.

katie (customer-success): Thanks — I'll set expectations in the kickoff email (call includes Peregrine security + compliance, 30m). I'll attach the pre-call checklist and ask them for any specific time ranges they care about.

maria (sec-eng): Ping @jamie @srini once export completes so I can start redaction + signing.

deploy-bot: audit-export job completed: job_id=jekyll-882, size=24MB, sha256=abcd1234ef567890.

jamie (security): Got it — downloading artifacts now.

srini (infra): Uploaded artifact to s3://redwood-evidence/peregrine/5067891230.tar.gz (presigned link, expires in 7 days).

maria (sec-eng): Received. Beginning redaction and GPG signing now. Will post final packet link when ready. :thumbsup:
